2026-10-23-14.title: Apply a template to your project
2026-10-23-14.body: Now the leader of a project can apply a template to an ongoing project. Open the project menu and press Apply a template. Madar adds the stages and tasks that the project does not have yet, from today.

2026-10-23-13.title: Who changes a role
2026-10-23-13.body: Now only the Admin changes the role of a person. Management can read a role, but cannot change it.

2026-10-23-1.title: The project list
2026-10-23-1.body: Now the project list shows who works on each project. It shows 3 pictures, then a number such as +2 for the rest.

2026-10-23-2.title: Your profile photo
2026-10-23-2.body: Now a photo with a see-through background shows your glow behind it. Upload the photo again to see the glow.

2026-10-23-3.title: A new calendar
2026-10-23-3.body: Madar has its own calendar on a computer. Turn the mouse wheel to move one month. Press the month name to jump to another month or year. Press Today to come back.

2026-10-23-4.title: Archive a chat
2026-10-23-4.body: Now you can archive a chat. Point at the chat and press the three dots, or swipe the chat on a phone. A new message brings it back. The row Archived is under the search field.

2026-10-23-5.title: Group chats
2026-10-23-5.body: Now you can make a group chat with 2 or more people. Press New message, then New group. Press the number of people under the name of a group to see who is in it. You can send a file or a photo in any chat. In a chat, Arabic text runs from the right and English text from the left, also while you type.

2026-10-23-6.title: Agents read your chats
2026-10-23-6.body: Now your AI agent can read your chats and list the chats that wait for your reply. The AI agent of a colleague in a chat can read the messages of that chat. The agent of a person who is not in the chat cannot read it.

2026-10-23-7.title: Sub-companies
2026-10-23-7.body: Now the Admin can add the sub-companies of the office, each with a logo. A project picks its sub-company, and the logo shows beside the project picture.

2026-10-23-8.title: The project on the map
2026-10-23-8.body: Now you can pin the project on a map in Edit project. Search a place by name or paste a map link. The Dashboard has a Map tab. It shows the street map in Madar colors, with all the pins. The Location of a project is its pin. Madar takes the address from the map. The About panel of a project shows its place on a map. A button on each map opens it full screen.

2026-10-23-9.title: Open space
2026-10-23-9.body: Now Open space shows the office as a mind map of projects, stages and tasks. Open it from the Dashboard.

2026-10-23-10.title: Project templates
2026-10-23-10.body: Now a stage keeps its start and length after you add a task. The Admin can drag the stages of a project template, copy a template, and see its timeline. Each task and stage has a Waits for picker. The Admin can also send an update to the projects made from a template.

2026-10-23-11.title: Roles and rights
2026-10-23-11.body: Now the Admin can make a custom role and choose its rights.

2026-10-23-12.title: The office report
2026-10-23-12.body: Now a person with the report right can ask an AI agent for the full office report.
